title: Hydraulic Roller Lifters For Chevrolet Small Block 350 1967-2003 5.7L
body_html:
Introductions:

Our hydraulic roller lifters are designed for use with standard factory alignment bars (on engines originally equipped with hydraulic roller lifters).These precision-valved heavy-duty lifters are a drop-in replacement for OEM applications, they have vertical alignment bars and are designed for engines that did not originally come with hydraulic rollers, such as small and big block Chevys, Fords and Mopars. they can also be used to replace OEM-type hydraulic rollers and guide bars. Welcome to choose performance auto parts.

Feature:

100% brand new

High performance aftermarket products made in our own lifters factory with more than 10 years experience

A fast and affordable way to easily upgrade your car's appearance performance

CNC Machined for Maximum Accuracy

Forged, Heat Treated Chrome Alloy Steel Body for High Strength

Precision Machined and Heat Treated Internal Components

Specification:

Application:

for Chevrolet small block 265 1955-1957 4.3L

for Chevrolet small block 283 1957-1967 4.6L

for Chevrolet small block 327 1962-1969 5.4L

for Chevrolet small block 350 1967-2003 5.7L

for Chevrolet small block 302 1967-1969 4.9L

for Chevrolet small block 307 1968-1973 5.0L

for Chevrolet small block 400 1970-1981 6.6L
